تستنبطون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْبِطُونَ (tastanbiṭūna) /tas.tan.bi.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
# تُسْتَنْبَطُونَ (tustanbaṭūna) /tus.tan.ba.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
